### Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5 at half the cost of Fable 5
🔥🔥🔥🔥◯ Anthropic released Claude Opus 5, a new flagship AI model priced at roughly half the per-token cost of the competing Fable 5 model while delivering comparable performance on benchmarks. The launch intensifies price competition among frontier AI labs as they vie for enterprise and developer customers seeking cheaper high-capability models.
